General_UpdateAutoDescription.Text: When enabled, Snapwell connects to GitHub to fetch only the latest version information. Only a User-Agent containing the version is sent; no identifiers are sent. Off by default.
General_UpdateCheckNowDescription.Text: Press to connect once and check for updates.
General_UpdateStatusFailed: Couldn’t check for updates. Try again later.
General_UpdateStatusDevelopmentBuild: Development builds don’t check for updates.
General_UpdateStatusNoPublicKey: No public key is configured, so updates can’t be checked.
General_UpdateOfferRequired: Your version is below the minimum supported version. Please update.
General_UpdateSaveFailed: Couldn’t save the update settings. Check the file location and permissions.
Setup_UpdateDescription.Text: When enabled, Snapwell connects to GitHub to fetch only the latest version information. Only a User-Agent containing the version is sent; no identifiers are sent. Off by default.
Update.InstallBlock.DevelopmentBuild: Development builds can't update in the app.
Update.InstallBlock.MissingCache: Update information or its signature is missing. Click Check now to check again.
Update.InstallBlock.ArchitectureUnsuppor: This architecture can't update in the app.
Update.InstallBlock.DownloadForbidden: This package can't be downloaded in the app.
Update.InstallBlock.MissingExecutable: Snapwell.exe isn't in the same folder as Settings, so the app can't update.
Update.InstallBlock.InsufficientSpace: There is not enough free space to update. Free up at least twice the package size.
Update.InstallBlock.AnotherUpdateRunning: Another update is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
Update.Startup.AnotherUpdateRunning: Another update is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
Update.Result.RolledBack: The new version didn't start, so the previous version was restored.
Update.Result.InvalidManifest: The update information or signature is invalid. Click Check now to check again.
Update.Result.NotNewer: The downloaded version isn't newer than the current version.
Update.Result.Architecture: The downloaded version doesn't support this architecture.
Update.Result.InvalidPackage: The downloaded package is invalid. Try again.
Update.Result.ApplyRolledBack: The update couldn't be applied, so the previous version was restored.
Update.Result.Reinstall: Snapwell may be damaged. Reinstall it from the releases page.
Update.Result.IoError: Couldn't access the update files. Check the file location, free space, and permissions.
Update.Result.Busy: Another update is running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
Update.StartFailed: Couldn't start the update coordinator. Try again.
Update.Download.NetworkError: Couldn't download the update. Check your network connection.
Update.Download.Timeout: The update download timed out. Try again.
Update.Download.HttpStatus: The download server returned an error. Try again later.
Update.Download.SizeMismatch: The downloaded file size doesn't match. Try again.
Update.Download.HashMismatch: The downloaded file hash doesn't match. Try again.
Update.Download.InsecureRedirect: The download stopped because the redirect destination was unsafe.
Update.Download.IoError: Couldn't save the downloaded file. Check free space and permissions.
